browse: Finding a card in your Collection
Your Collection has the standard search, filter and sort options you’d expect to find anywhere else: search by name, filter by color, type or set, sort by name, quantity and more.
collection-add: Cracked a pack and don’t want to export your whole Collection for four cards?
availability: Availability: what’s free, what’s taken, what to buy
This is the one I mentioned earlier and is one of my favorite features, even if it’s a small one.
added-copy: You buy a Sol Ring for your new Brago deck.
remove-card: Removing a card from your Collection
When a card has really left your binder, take it out here.
ready-to-build: Every day, the Home page deals you two commanders you could build right now, picked from the best fits in your Collection that aren’t leading a deck of their own.
card-marks: A card’s bracket marks follow it everywhere: your Collection, your decklists, “Consider” and search.
combo-awareness: Some cards do something remarkable next to one other card.
friends: Playing with the same people every week?
resume: Pick up where you left off
The Home page opens on the four decks you touched last, so you can jump right back in.
commitments: How much of your Collection is in use
Three numbers on the Home page show how hard your decks are leaning on your Collection.
themes: Six themes live in the account menu under “Theme”, from Low Sun to First Frost.
